title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Mileage Allowance After a Pull-Ahead, Early Termination or Mid-Extension Turn-In
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — mileage allowance conventions for leases that end off their term**

**1. Pull-ahead or early termination: by the whole month.** The mileage allowance of a lease that ended in a pull-ahead or an early termination — its termination type on the lease record — runs by the whole month: the annual mileage allowance divided by 12 times the whole months from the lease date to the turn-in date, rounded down to a whole mile, a month being counted only when the day of the month of the turn-in date is on or after that of the lease date.

**2. Turned in during a maturity extension, before the current maturity date: by the day.** The mileage allowance of any other lease turned in during a maturity extension — a lease showing extension months used — before its current maturity date runs by the day: the annual mileage allowance times the calendar days from the lease date to the turn-in date, counted from the day after the lease date through the turn-in date, divided by the 365 days in a year, rounded down to a whole mile.

**3.** Neither convention applies to any other lease.

**Whole months (hypothetical dates)**

| Lease date | Turn-in date | Whole months |
|---|---|---|
| January 15, 2023 | November 15, 2024 | 22 |
| January 15, 2023 | November 14, 2024 | 21 |
| January 31, 2023 | February 28, 2023 | 0 |

**Worked figures (hypothetical)**

- Early termination; annual allowance 12000 miles; lease date January 15, 2023; turn-in November 14, 2024: 21 whole months; 12000 divided by 12 times 21 is 21000 miles.
- Pull-ahead; annual allowance 10000 miles; 22 whole months: 10000 divided by 12 times 22 is 18333.33…, rounded down to 18333 miles.
- Turned in during a maturity extension before the current maturity date; annual allowance 12000 miles; lease date January 10, 2022; turn-in March 1, 2025: 1146 calendar days; 12000 times 1146 divided by 365 is 37676.71…, rounded down to 37676 miles.
- Turned in during a maturity extension on its current maturity date: neither convention applies.
